transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, October 29. transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Arab parties claim kingmaker status in Israel elections. Joint list open to Eisenkot minority government; Ra'am's Abbas says 'everyone talking to us' Spain train crash: How a system failure and red signal led to a deadly collision. A high-speed train operated by Spain's state-owned RENFE collided with a stationary IRYO train in Toledo, killing at least 68 people. Big setback for New Zealand! Star player ruled out of India T20I series. Lockie Ferguson, New Zealand's fast bowler, is out of the ongoing T20I series against India due to a calf injury. With India already leading 3-0, the team has summoned Matt Fisher to enhance their bowling strength. Concurrently, Matt Henry is on the mend from a quadricep injury but is expected to rejoin for the upcoming ODI clashes. IMD issues yellow alert for Delhi-NCR; rain, thunderstorms and hailstorms likely. A yellow alert has been issued for rain and thunderstorms in Delhi-NCR for Thursday and Friday. The IMD forecasts a generally cloudy sky with winds reaching 40-50 kmph during the morning. Light to moderate rainfall is expected along with possible hailstorms in the region. Residents are advised to remain cautious during thunderstorms and strong winds. Amazon layoffs hit devices and services unit, email cites 'review of our structure'. Amazon has confirmed plans to cut approximately 250 jobs in its devices and services division. These layoffs follow recent product launches, including new Kindle e-readers and tablet computers. This decision aims to improve operational efficiency and align with the company's product roadmap. Earlier this year, Amazon announced significant job reductions, further indicating structural changes within the organization. 3 Wall Street firms agree to pay up to $100,000 a month to get Trump's posts faster. Donald Trump's Truth API, a subscription-based social media service, is attracting a diverse clientele, including Bloomberg and various trading firms, by offering rapid access to his posts. This service's growing popularity raises ethical questions about the commercialization of presidential communication and its potential effects on market dynamics. Amid ongoing legal challenges and mounting criticism, Trump's media company faces heightened scrutiny due to its reduced market value and controversial business practices. Four friends turned homemade cinnamon rolls into a $7m business on Target shelves. Sunshine Buns has successfully secured $7 million in Series A funding, allowing them to broaden their store presence. Founded by four friends using a family cinnamon roll recipe, their frozen delights are now featured in major retailers like Target and Costco. This new funding will support production and marketing efforts, and the founders attribute their success to local mentors and the nurturing startup community in Utah. In setback to BJP, Congress wins Nagpur MLC seat. Abhijeet Wanjari from Congress has retained the Nagpur Division Graduates' constituency seat after a tight election. He defeated BJP's Sudhakar Kohale by 3,271 votes following over 40 hours of counting. Kohale initially led during the second round of counting but Wanjari eventually prevailed. The elections for Maharashtra legislative council were conducted for five constituencies, reflecting some differences within the ruling Mahayuti alliance. Yet to test legality of logical discrepancy in SIR: Supreme Court. The Supreme Court on Wednesday said that even though the validity of SIR in Bihar was upheld, the court had no occasion to test the legality of the 'logical discrepancy' criterion as it was not used during the Bihar exercise. Mystery surrounds deaths of Ayurveda hospital owner, son, daughter. Aarti Soni, along with her children Nilkanth and Jainy, was found dead in their home. The domestic worker's concern led to the discovery of the bodies hanging from a ceiling fan. Investigators suspect the deaths occurred several days prior due to a foul smell. Aarti had recently made plans to expand her family's Ayurveda hospital, which they managed after her husband's death. 'From the river to the sea': Hundreds rally across Israel advocating Jewish-Arab gov. Around 300 demonstrators gathered in Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and Haifa to demand a Jewish-Arab government. Protesters held signs advocating for freedom and inclusive governance, reflecting their unified call. The demonstrations coincided with ongoing vote counting following Israel's closely contested election. Pro-Netanyahu parties secured 53 seats, while the opposing bloc held 48, leaving no clear majority.
